topic: Best Friends Day: Mishi and Bruno remember all their favourite adventures.

episode.title: Mishi & Bruno: A Box Full of Friendship

shots.narration: How can all their adventures fit inside one tiny box?
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, warm 3D animated living room with rounded furniture. An open little box overflows with a ball, pinwheel and dry leaf boat. No text.
shots.action: Bruno tilts the overflowing box toward Mishi.
shots.mood: Sunny colours, curious wide eyes, playful anticipation.

shots.narration: On Best Friends Day, Mishi had a lovely idea.
shots.scene: Cosy colourful living room, soft warm lighting, vertical 9:16. The open memory box rests between the fluffy grey kitten and golden-brown puppy.
shots.action: Mishi gently pats the little memory box.

shots.narration: [chuckles] Bruno remembered their bouncy ball adventure.
shots.scene: Warm 3D living room, vertical 9:16. Rounded sofa cushions form a small mound beside the memory box.
shots.action: Bruno lifts the colourful ball above the box.
shots.mood: Delighted puppy grin, bright playful colours.

shots.narration: Mishi remembered their pinwheel spinning in the garden breeze.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16 beside an open garden doorway, sunny flowers outside, soft 3D family-film lighting.
shots.action: Mishi holds the pinwheel in the gentle breeze.
shots.mood: Peaceful wonder, colourful spinning blades, sparkling green eyes.

shots.narration: Their little leaf boat had sailed across a puddle.
shots.scene: Cosy living room floor beside the garden doorway, vertical 9:16. The dry leaf boat rests near the open box.
shots.action: Mishi lifts the leaf boat on one careful paw.
shots.mood: Tender smiles, soft sunlight, treasured little discovery.

shots.narration: [surprised] But their favourite memories simply wouldn't fit!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16 close view of the full memory box on the rounded living room rug. The ball keeps its lid raised.
shots.action: Bruno gently presses the lid against the protruding ball.
shots.mood: Comically puzzled faces, gentle frustration, warm colours.

shots.narration: Mishi knew their memories needed somewhere bigger.
shots.scene: Sunny living room with clear floor space beside the memory box, vertical 9:16, soft rounded 3D shapes.
shots.action: Mishi spreads a colourful picnic blanket across the floor.
shots.mood: Brightening expressions, cosy fabric, hopeful warmth.

shots.narration: Bruno added their ball to the memory picnic.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16 view of the colourful blanket in the sunlit living room, with the open box beside it.
shots.action: Bruno places the ball on the blanket.
shots.mood: Proud puppy smile, cheerful colours, soft sunlight.

shots.narration: [giggles] Mishi found a perfect spot for their tiny boat.
shots.scene: Warm 3D living room, vertical 9:16. The ball rests on one corner of the colourful blanket.
shots.action: Mishi places the leaf boat beside the ball.
shots.mood: Careful paws, delighted green eyes, cosy golden glow.

shots.narration: Their pinwheel made the collection complete.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, colourful blanket displaying the ball and leaf boat, softly lit rounded furniture behind.
shots.action: Bruno lays the pinwheel beside the leaf boat.
shots.mood: Satisfied smile, rich colours, gentle celebration.

shots.narration: Their favourite part of every adventure was being together.
shots.scene: Wide vertical 9:16 living room composition. The three keepsakes sit clearly displayed on the blanket beside the friends.
shots.action: Mishi and Bruno snuggle shoulder to shoulder on the blanket.
shots.mood: Affectionate smiles, peaceful friendship, soft amber sunlight.

shots.narration: [excited] Share happy memories; tomorrow, let's plant something together!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16 beside the sunny garden doorway. The memory picnic fills the foreground; an empty flowerpot and small watering can sit outside.
shots.action: Mishi points toward the empty flowerpot.
shots.mood: Hopeful smiles, inviting garden colours, warm anticipation.

episode.endHook: Tomorrow, Mishi and Bruno plant something together!
episode.description: For Best Friends Day, Mishi and Bruno collect reminders of their favourite adventures. When their little memory box won't close, they discover a cosy way to celebrate together.
